explication: SophiApp is a Windows 10/11 configuration app: it checks system requirements, presents applicable settings, and applies user-selected tweaks. The principal path runs from app startup through initialization and the shell workflow to UI models and customization mutators, which change Windows state through platform services. The README describes more than 130 tweaks; the tree also shows dedicated privacy, security, system, personalization, UWP, and task-scheduler surfaces. Several subsystem links are omitted because their callers were not shown in the sampled source.
